source_evidence: Every investment product has its own set of features. The products that are right for you depend in part on your specific goals, investing timeframe, and risk tolerance.
answer: Investment products are different ways to invest, such as stocks, bonds, mutual funds, ETFs, and annuities. Each has its own features, so consider how an investment fits your goals, timeframe, and risk tolerance. Also consider its potential risk and return, fees, liquidity, and whether diversification could help spread risk. All investments involve risk, and you can lose some or all of your money.
